summary: Verified all three estimates against the cited PDF pages and the extraction rules/codebook. Read the entire 819-line markdown conversion through the references; the supplied 16-page PDF has no appended appendix or embedded supplement. Confirmed all recorded means, paper-labeled SDs, tests, significance bounds, the OLS coefficient, and the OLS observation count; recovered Tables 1-3 with pymupdf.find_tables. Confirmed the randomized unequal-versus-full AI contrast, outcome coding, timing, units, and uncertainty bases. The 120 people recruited/randomized, baseline arm counts of 40 and 20 teams, and 120 OLS submission observations are distinguished correctly; unprinted analysis-specific people counts remain null. The OLS coefficient is printed as full minus unequal access and its direction is explicitly documented. No eligible outcome or total arm contrast is missing from the supplied paper: fixed-order no-AI comparisons, baseline balance tests, mediation/mediator-adjusted results (including originality), and task completion time are correctly excluded. The paper’s conflicting SD/SEM labels and Table 1 SD/t-statistic labels are already flagged in the extraction; verification confirms transcription, not resolution of those source inconsistencies. Completeness is limited to the supplied article: requests to the named Frontiers supplementary-material URL and the article DOI both failed with WinError 10013, so the external supplement remains unverified.
